notes: Cranswick plc (LSE: CWK) — UK's largest premium pork producer/processor and a major poultry / cooked-meats / Mediterranean foods business. Vertically integrated across pig farming (own + 3rd-party), abattoirs, primary processing, and value-added (sausage, bacon, charcuterie, ready-to-cook). Customers: Tesco, Sainsbury's, M&S, Aldi, Lidl, plus food-service. Fiscal year ends late March (52/53-wk). Long history of double-digit organic + bolt-on revenue growth. UK pork pricing recovered FY24-FY25 after FY22 cyclical low. Recently expanded into pet food via Inspired Pet Nutrition acquisition (Aug 2024). Annual reports at cranswick.plc.uk/investors.

periods.notes: FY21 (yr-end Mar 2021): revenue £1.90B. COVID retail tailwind. Adj op profit £121.4M. EPS ~190p.
FY22: revenue £2.01B (+6%). Adj op profit £126M. UK pig-farming labour shortage + CO2 supply crisis disrupted parts of FY. EPS ~178p.
FY23: revenue £2.32B (+15%). Inflation pass-through. Adj op profit £132M. Continental Europe + poultry growth. EPS ~187p.
FY24: revenue £2.60B (+12%). Adj op profit £171M (+30%). Strong volume + margin recovery. EPS ~242p. Continued capex on Hull pork facility + poultry expansion.
FY25: revenue £2.72B (+5%). Adj op profit £193M (+13%). Inspired Pet Nutrition (acquired Aug 2024) added new pet-food vertical. EPS ~285p. Dividend 100p (+9%).
